scope: Synthetic direct calls and isolated local product API; production and installed clients were not measured.
percentile_method: Nearest rank among successful attempts only; a missing timing is excluded from that metric denominator.

constraints.deadline_note: Elapsed deadline is checked between chunks; a blocking read has its own HTTP operation timeout.
constraints.quality_note: Russian text and arithmetic heuristics are not an independent semantic quality review.

constraints.candidate_note: Candidate measurements used an equivalent in-memory method replacement before the source patch; final source has separate focused tests.
constraints.wire_note: Candidate records verify explicit reasoning disabled on every wire call. Original wire omission is independently confirmed by the instrumented SDK harness, rather than by absent metadata in these original rows.
constraints.latency_note: Auth sums POST and event-stream access checks. Stages overlap; do not add medians. Provider content is raw; visible SSE follows normal processing.
constraints.comparison_note: Sequential small batches selected different actual models on a dynamic router and ran during other local test load. This is not a controlled causal comparison or a production latency measurement.
constraints.error_note: Candidate HTTP 400 bodies were not retained; the cause of each individual refusal cannot be established from this evidence.

fixed_model_candidate_exploratory_pooled.limitation: Two concurrent runs wrote to one report with repeated sample indices and no run identifier. Only pooled 40-observation statistics are supported; individual-run statistics and a clean comparison are not supported.

regression.revision_limitation: First 939 file results precede the optional profile patch. The 324-file continuation started before and ended after that patch. Combined coverage is a mixed-revision run, not a clean final-source or prepatch baseline.
regression.count_limitation: Reported pytest summaries supply test counts. Files with no summary have no inferred test counts. Causality or preexistence of failures has not been established.

records.reservation_rule: wire JSON bytes + 2048 input tokens; bounded output; reconcile actual usage.cost

paid_cheaper_candidate.limitation: One greeting call returned HTTP 429. No successful latency, language-quality, planning, or tool result exists. The missing usage receipt holds the worst-case reservation. Reported receipt cost of zero does not prove a zero charge.
